payload.title: SM120 NVFP4 Decode GEMM Production Lessons
payload.summary: This report summarizes the reusable SM120 NVFP4 decode and prefill GEMM knowledge distilled from the omoExplore wiki. It intentionally removes experiment numbering and keeps only the stable engineering conclusions.

sections.heading: Shape Taxonomy
sections.gist: table columns: Shape family, Typical dimensions, Production lesson

sections.heading: Split-K Dispatch Rule
sections.gist: Split-K is a parallelism fix for shapes with too few output CTAs.

sections.heading: CUDA Graph Methodology
sections.gist: CUDA Graph replay removes Python dispatch, C++ wrapper overhead, CPU-side kernel launch cost, and CPU-side descriptor creation.

sections.heading: CTA-3D TMA Improvement
sections.gist: The best scoped C2-only follow-up changed the B-load structure rather than only tuning split count or tile width.

sections.heading: Cold Weight-Streaming GEMV Residency Lever
sections.gist: For a latency-bound, cold-cache, weight-streaming GEMV with visible bandwidth headroom, the useful lever is the number of resident blocks per SM, not deeper per-block prefetching.

sections.heading: Structural DRAM-Bandwidth Ceiling
sections.gist: For `M=1..16,N=16384,K=5120` NVFP4 decode GEMM, the local ATREX-style multi-wave split-K route could not reliably beat a FlashInfer/CUTLASS b12x route already near the memory roofline.

sections.heading: Prefill and Fusion Boundary
sections.gist: For large-M prefill, forced b12x tactics on gate/up were too small and inconsistent to justify production routing.

implementation.snippet:
```text
Use Split-K only when:
  M == 1
  N is small enough to under-fill the GPU
  K/S satisfies the kernel alignment contract
  workspace lifetime is stable across CUDA Graph capture/replay

Use CUTLASS / FlashInfer otherwise:
  C1-like large-N decode
  batched decode
  prefill
  any shape whose base grid is already saturated
```

```text
global_dims   = [K_split / 2, N, S]
global_strides = [K / 2, K_split / 2]
box           = [64 bytes, 8 N rows, S]
```

```text
gate_up GEMM -> SiLU*Mul -> NVFP4 payload/scale for down_proj
```
